title: Members ask a Space for a scannable badge, and staff write it from the CyberUnicorn in the admin menu

source.ref: §7 Badge requests. Owner 2026-10-20 in the project thread: the Unicorn app belongs in the menu for Admin and Janitor, not on the Space page; put a CTA to get a scannable badge on the Space page. Decision card the same day: the button files a request that waits in a queue in the Unicorn app.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. PREMISE RE-TESTED: the CyberUnicorn console (LIVE-1168) sat in a Space's Check in tab, gated on the Space owner, and a member had no way to ask for a card. Built: migration 20270346018000_badge_requests.sql (badge_requests, service role only, one pending row per member per Space); lib/devices/badges.ts (readBadgeState, fileBadgeRequest, and the staff-only listBadgeRequests, closeBadgeRequestForCard, cancelBadgeRequest, findSpaceForConsole); lib/devices/badge-actions.ts (requestBadge, dismissBadgeRequest, lookupConsoleSpace); consoleStaffGate in lib/devices/store.ts (web_role admin or janitor) now gates the three console writes; finishConsoleCard closes the member's request. /admin/cyberunicorn (requireAdmin admin, Growth > Acquisition, studio leaf `cyberunicorn`) mounts the console with the request queue, a Space picker and a handle field. The Space page shows a badge line under the Regulars line on both layout branches: Get a scannable badge, Badge requested, or Your badge works here. The Check in tab keeps Counter scanners and Member cards and says members ask from the Space page. EVIDENCE 2026-10-20: the migration must be applied to production before the request button works (reads fail safe to no request).

verify.note: Fails when the console is back on a Space page or leaves its staff-only admin page and menu row, when a queue or console write loses its staff gate, when writing a card stops closing the request, when the Space page loses the badge line on either branch, or when badge_requests stops being service role only with one pending row per member.
